records.goalTitle: Volumina von Quadern und Würfeln bestimmen

observations: The left prism shows a 3-by-2 top grid, a 3-by-2 front grid and a 2-by-2 side grid, consistent with 3×2×2=12 unit cubes.
The right cube shows 2-by-2 grids on all three visible faces, consistent with 2×2×2=8 unit cubes.
No in-image numbers, formulas, measurements or overlapping solids can introduce an arithmetic contradiction.
selfReview.remainingConcern: The two separately rendered solids may differ slightly in apparent projected unit-cube size; independent review should judge whether same-scale comparison is sufficiently clear before any active import. The image does not teach unit conversion by itself.

observations: The step solid separates a lower teal 4×2×1 cuboid (8 unit cubes) and an upper amber 2×2×1 cuboid (4 unit cubes), aligned over the left half with a visible color boundary and no visible gap or overlap.
The selected revision removes distracting faces and adds the missing upper side-grid seam; the resulting regular front/top/right-side subdivisions support counting the two additive parts.
No in-image formula claims a result the drawing cannot support; the visual covers one valid decomposition method, not the alternative complement-and-subtract method.
selfReview.remainingConcern: Independent review must inspect hidden-volume interpretation and whether all projected unit seams are coherent; generation alone is not an image or P approval.
